medicalDisclaimer: For awareness only. This is not medical advice. Do not rely on this app alone for health or safety decisions.
pollutantNote: Pollutant concentrations and the US AQI come from the station separately. They are not calculated from each other, and stations only report the pollutants they measure.
mapNote: Markers show individual monitoring stations, not measured pollution coverage of the whole area.
sourceHelp.official: A reading from an official monitoring station, as reported by its data provider.
sourceHelp.community: A community-contributed reading. This badge does not certify accuracy.
homeCommunityBody: See something affecting the air? Report it to the community.
airCompositionNote: CO is shown in mg/m3; other pollutants in micrograms/m3. A dash means this station does not report that pollutant.
compare.description: Compare two stations side by side without losing the context.
riskNote: The risk level is guidance based on the reading and your profile. It does not change the station's AQI.
noProfileForAdvice: Create an optional profile for personalised advice.
noProfileBody: An optional health profile helps explain why the same reading can mean different things for different people.
noAlertsBody: Create a rule for a saved location. Alerts show in the app while it is open; email and push delivery are not set up yet.
alertDemoNotice: Your alert rules are saved to your account. Email and push delivery are not set up yet, so triggered alerts only appear in the app.
profile.description: All fields are optional. Share only what you find useful.
profilePrivacyBody: Your profile is stored with your account and used only to personalise advice. It is optional, never shared, and you can delete it at any time. It is not a medical record.
clearProfileBody: This removes the profile from your account. Your saved areas and alerts are not affected.
reportSent: Your report has been added as unverified.
noReportsBody: Try another filter or add the first report.
reportStatusHelp: Status shows where the report is in moderation. It is not official confirmation of an incident.
sourceGuideBody: An official source, a community reading and a model estimate are different kinds of evidence. Check the timestamp and avoid treating a nearby station as a measurement of your exact location.
faq1a: Readings come from official monitoring stations and the sources shown on each reading, and can be a few hours behind. Always check the timestamp.
faq4a: No. The advisory explains how the air-quality reading and the profile details you share lead to a recommendation. It is not a diagnosis or treatment advice.
demoPrivacy: Your account, optional health profile, saved places and alerts are stored on the Aero Health server only to provide the service. Share only what you are comfortable with.
